testsuite.name: com.chromascape.web.debug.patchloop.service.provider.mcp.McpTransportClientTest

testcase.name: healthCheck() returns unhealthy when healthy field is invalid/non-boolean
healthCheck() handles response with metadata
healthCheck() respects max-retries configuration
healthCheck() retries on transient failures
healthCheck() throws INVALID_RESPONSE on malformed JSON
healthCheck() throws TIMEOUT on connection timeout
healthCheck() returns false when MCP server returns unhealthy status
healthCheck() throws CONNECTION_REFUSED or TIMEOUT on connection refused
analyze() throws SERIALIZATION_ERROR on null request
Constructor initializes HttpClient with correct configuration
healthCheck() returns true when MCP server returns healthy status
analyze() returns valid response on success
analyze() throws HTTP_ERROR on 500 with retry
analyze() throws TIMEOUT on timeout
healthCheck() handles missing optional fields
healthCheck() throws CONFIGURATION_ERROR on 400 status code
healthCheck() throws AUTH_FAILED on 401
healthCheck() throws AUTH_FAILED on 403
healthCheck() throws RATE_LIMIT on 429 with isRetryable=true
healthCheck() throws HTTP_ERROR on 500 status code
healthCheck() returns unhealthy when healthy field is missing
analyze() throws INVALID_RESPONSE on malformed JSON
analyze() throws AUTH_FAILED on 401
analyze() throws AUTH_FAILED on 403
healthCheck() returns structured unhealthy payload from non-2xx health response
